metadata.note: Intent labels derived from manual inspection of cluster samples + LLM labeling. Banking77 used as structural reference for taxonomy granularity.

0.description: Problems caused by iOS updates — slowness, WiFi issues, functionality broken after updating
example_messages: I installed iOS 11.0.2 on my iPad Mini 4. Now my WiFi speed is really slow.
iPhone SE freezing after recent ios 11 upgrade. Knocked battery life in half.
what about fixing your keyboard in iOS 11... is soooo slow!
